from funcy import cache

@cache(60)
def f(x):
    return x * 2

# Call with x=5 -> key = (5,)
r1 = f(5)
print(f"First call: {r1}")

# Invalidate with 5 -> key_func(5) = (5,) -> pops (5,) from cache
f.invalidate(5)

# Check if it was removed
r2 = f(5)
print(f"After invalidate: {r2}")
